purpose: Current-source artifact qualification for bounded early-error retention; synthetic local process cost, not whole-task efficacy or billing evidence.
ordering: Rotate fixtures each round and rotate the three arms within each fixture; no trimming or outlier removal.
material_regression_rule: For each fixture, median paired candidate-minus-baseline wall time must not exceed max(20 ms, 25% of baseline median wall time). This is an explicit artifact acceptance budget for this local experiment, not a latency guarantee or inferred task-speed benefit.
requirements: early marker retained for declared applicable fixtures
limitations: Fixtures and thresholds are development decisions, not an unused task holdout.
The prior sampler overhead observation motivated an optimization; this is qualification after that development, not independent confirmation.
Shared-host timing is noisy; report every observation and do not discard an unfavorable run.
Native quiet reporters, model behavior, later log reads, and whole-task cost are not measured.
